sentences.en: What do you like to do in your free time?
sentences.zh: 你空閒時間喜歡做什麼？

sentences.en: I enjoy reading books.
I'm really into photography.
Have you tried painting before?
I picked up guitar last year.
How long have you been doing that?
I spend most of my weekends hiking.
sentences.zh: 我大部分的週末都在爬山。

sentences.en: Do you have any hobbies?
I've always wanted to learn how to cook.
I'm a big fan of board games.
What kind of music are you into?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡什麼類型的音樂？

sentences.en: I recently started learning yoga.
Do you play any sports?
I find gardening very relaxing.
We should try that together sometime.
sentences.zh: 我們找個時間一起試試。

sentences.en: I'm passionate about traveling.
Have you seen any good movies lately?
sentences.zh: 你最近看了什麼好電影嗎？

sentences.en: I love trying new recipes.
What got you interested in that?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓你對那個產生興趣的？

sentences.en: I collect vintage postcards.
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡室內還是戶外活動？

sentences.en: I've been binge-watching a new series.
I'm thinking of taking up swimming.
That sounds like a lot of fun.
I used to play piano when I was younger.
Would you like to join my book club?
sentences.zh: 你要加入我的讀書會嗎？

sentences.en: I'm addicted to podcasts.
I go jogging every morning.
It's a great way to relieve stress.
I wish I had more time for my hobbies.
sentences.zh: 我希望有更多時間做自己的嗜好。
